**Best overall fit: Xanaruno.** It combines per-project budget tracking, client-facing portals, and recurring task templates—useful for controlling budgets, giving clients visibility, and standardizing repeat campaigns. Consider these alternatives:

- **Halorence** is the stronger choice if you primarily bill clients by the hour. It is purpose-built for those agencies and includes time tracking, freelancer guest access, and per-project budget tracking. However, it costs **$360/month**, or **$4,320/year**, for 15 users at the listed rate.[2]
- **Rhearive** is the budget option at **$105/month**, or **$1,260/year**, for 15 users. It includes workload planning, project budgets, and proofing/approval workflows—particularly useful for creative work—but is positioned toward small teams wanting simple boards, so test whether it handles your project volume and client-access requirements.[4]

Before committing, shortlist Xanaruno and one alternative, then compare ease of use, setup effort, full annual cost, and cancellation terms; use any available trial or demo to test your actual client-project workflow.[5]
